# Carmel Valley Condos

> Carmel Valley condos and townhomes for sale in San Diego, CA 92130. Community guides, sold data, HOA details, and market reports by Sez Sezer, Keller Williams Realty (DRE #01988197) - 858-436-6585, sez@carmelvalley.com, 12750 High Bluff Drive, San Diego, CA 92130.

Every page listed below has a clean Markdown version at the same path (index.md). Structured community facts are in [communities.json](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/data/communities.json); the full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/llms-full.txt).

## Overview

- [Carmel Valley Condo & Townhome Communities (Directory)](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/index.md): Home page: directory of every condo and townhome community in Carmel Valley (San Diego, CA 92130) - map, sortable list with home counts, how to choose a community, live listings, and links to each community guide.

## Communities

- [Carmel Valley Condos for Sale](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/carmel-valley-condos-for-sale/index.md): Guide to Carmel Valley condo communities, prices, HOA fees, and live 92130 condo listings.
- [Carmel Valley Townhomes for Sale](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/carmel-valley-townhomes-for-sale/index.md): Guide to Carmel Valley townhome communities, prices, HOA fees, and live 92130 townhome listings.
- [Arborlake Carmel Valley Condos for Sale](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/arborlake-carmel-valley/index.md): Arborlake: 190-unit lake-and-waterfall condo community (built 1986-1989) - prices by bedroom count, HOA, sold data, schools, FAQs.
- [Carmel Pointe Carmel Valley Condos for Sale](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/carmel-pointe-carmel-valley/index.md): Carmel Pointe: 200-unit condo community (built 2001-2002) with underground garage parking and a utility-inclusive HOA - prices by bedroom count, HOA, sold data, schools, FAQs.
- [The Lakes Condos for Sale](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/the-lakes-condos-for-sale/index.md): The Lakes: 192-unit condo community (built 1984-1985) set around five small lakes and koi ponds, no Mello-Roos - prices by bedroom count, HOA, sold data, schools, FAQs.
- [Del Mar Villas Carmel Valley Condos for Sale](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/del-mar-villas-carmel-valley/index.md): Del Mar Villas: 216-home condo community (built 1990, condos since 2004) of single-level 1- and 2-bedrooms near Carmel Valley's schools - prices by bedroom count, monthly dues, sold data, FAQs.
- [Camino Villas Condos for Sale](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/camino-villas-condos-for-sale/index.md): Camino Villas: 316-home condo community (built 1993-1997) with a pool, spa and tennis - recent sold prices by bedroom count, monthly dues, Mello-Roos, schools, FAQs.
- [The Heights Townhomes for Sale](https://www.carmelvalleycondos.com/the-heights-townhomes-for-sale/index.md): The Heights: gated community built in 2003 on Carmel Country Road with 1- to 3-bedroom homes - recent sold prices by bedroom count, monthly dues, Mello-Roos, schools, FAQs.
